description: The clinical lead's sign-off of each version of the national medicine and lab-test lists (owner decision Q124 A, 19 November 2026). The governed loader (services/ehr-api/scripts/load-catalog.mjs) loads a seed file only when an entry here names its sha256, kind and version, and records this file's own sha256 with the version. A medicine entry also records the owner's licence answers under "licences", each a reference to where the answer is kept: "nigeriaEml8" (the confirmation that the Nigeria EML 8th edition may be used), always; "whoccAtc" (the WHOCC terms answer), before a file with ATC codes is built or loaded. Each entry is added in a reviewed PR that records the lead's sign-off; no personal names here, only the reference to that record. The migration image carries this file, and in production the loader takes no other.
